No raw secret/token/phone/email/address/bank/tax code or raw psid/customer/guest id anywhere in the corpus (test fixtures use synthetic non-PII ids). CONSENT ENFORCEMENT solid: RetargetingMeasurement.is_eligible requires BOTH a recognized engagement signal AND ConsentGate.evaluate(snapshot, ConsentScope.AUDIENCE_SYNC), reusing the EXISTING audience-sync scope (no new scope invented, RULE-018); missing/expired/opt-out/scope-not-granted/unrecognized -> not eligible; measure-only (holds only the consent gate, no Transport/outbox/connector handle; counts, never sends; external_send=OFF). ConsentGate.evaluate is hardened (coerce-or-deny on the requested scope; fail-closed on absent snapshot; rejects untrusted consent_scope type; materializes a REAL frozenset before the membership test, defeating a __contains__-override fail-open -- the M6.2B/M6.2D MAJOR-7 fixes) and PII-safe: every DENY audits through AuditLog.record where subject is MASKED (subject_masked) and detail carries only the machine enum scope.value. UNTRUSTED-INPUT: the funnel reads channel-derived attribution_context values (comment_id/messenger_thread_id/psid/live_session_id) purely as DATA threaded into a trace -- never executed or interpreted as instructions; golden-hour signals go through observe_state, fail-closed to UNKNOWN for anything non-canonical; event codes are registry-validated upstream (RULE-001), stage_for returns None for an unrecognized/non-str code. (Cross-ref, NOT this reviewer's gate: the boundary report's F-FUNNEL-1 str-subclass event_code.__eq__ and F-FUNNEL-2/3 hostile Mapping.get/TOCTOU both require arbitrary in-process code execution and are NOT channel-reachable -- process-integrity items routed to CODER, outside the PII surface.) FORWARD REQUIREMENT (ACCESS, owner integration M6-OD-011): when the funnel view is eventually surfaced through GET /api/admin/ads/dashboard, the binding step must (a) authenticate/authorize an admin caller per doc 22 line 429 (the existing handle_dashboard_request does not itself authenticate; the HTTP/auth mapping is deferred to M6-OD-011 -> enforce caller identity at that seam, never trust it from the request body) and (b) apply the trace-id masking discipline (F-SEC-2I-1/2) at that export boundary; mirrors the ACCESS-1 forward requirement raised at M6.2G/M6.2H and stays a hard forward gate. HASH POLICY / M6-OD-003: N/A (honest, not BLOCKED) -- OD-003 governs the EXTERNAL-SEND hash policy (which identity fields leave hashed vs raw in an outbound payload); M6.2I's funnel is a measure-only projection that builds no external payload and sends nothing, so OD-003 is not this slice's core deliverable and does not block its security review, consistent with the scoping across M6.2A/B/C/E/F/G/H (BLOCKED only at M6.2D where external-send hashing IS the deliverable); the carried HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False remains correctly fail-closed and nothing in this slice consumes it to send. IN-SCOPE FAIL GATES from the PII/security angle: M6-FAIL-001 (revenue misuse) NOT tripped -- no PII/secret path books or leaks revenue; the revenue choke is the self-enforcing event_code==ORDER_VERIFIED ANDed with revenue presence (only the in-process, not-channel-reachable F-FUNNEL-1 can defeat it -> CODER). M6-FAIL-010 (phase jump) NOT tripped -- the funnel is measure-only, imports no scale/learning/outbox/dispatcher/transport module, and adds no new authenticated surface. FINDINGS (all armed-not-fired; none trips an in-scope gate; routed): F-SEC-2I-1 [primary; = boundary F-FUNNEL-4; CODER+owner] cross-person trace stitch -- GoldenHourFunnel._trace folds comment_id/messenger_thread_id/psid each INDEPENDENTLY with x = x or ctx.get(x) across ALL events grouped under one live_session_id (a session-level shared key: one live broadcast, many people) with NO subject binding (no customer_or_guest_key), so a multi-subject session stitches personA.comment_id next to personB.messenger_thread_id (+ personC psid) into one exported FunnelTrace, asserting a FALSE association between distinct identifiable people; masking psid does not cure it (the harm is the fabricated linkage, and comment_id/messenger_thread_id are exported raw); armed-not-fired for a hard breach only because the canonical tests use one-subject sessions; fix: bind the trace to a single subject (customer_or_guest_key) or record per-subject traces; does not trip FAIL-001/010. F-SEC-2I-2 [CODER+owner, M6-OD-012] raw trace-id export / masking-scope inconsistency -- FunnelTrace.to_public masks ONLY psid; comment_id/messenger_thread_id/live_session_id are exported RAW; messenger_thread_id is a per-person Messenger conversation handle (same identity-boundary family as psid, resolves 1:1 to one person's DM thread), so masking psid while exporting messenger_thread_id raw is an inconsistency; M6-OD-012 (masking format/scope) is OPEN so the exact scope is an owner decision (pack invents none); fix/decision: ratify the export masking scope, at minimum bring messenger_thread_id to psid parity; parallels the M6.2E O-2b observation; interacts with F-SEC-2I-1. N-1 [CODER/DQ; carried from boundary] non-finite verified revenue -- _verified_revenue sums e.revenue_value for ORDER_VERIFIED rows with no isfinite/>=0 guard, so a NaN/Inf on a genuine verified row poisons verified_revenue; data-quality robustness, not a PII/secret issue and not an in-scope gate (RULE-003 still holds; the value only originates from an ORDER_VERIFIED row); fix: guard the summand (math.isfinite(v) and v>=0). GOVERNANCE: analysis_only -- no application code, migration, state ledger, or flag written; no external/network call; no live session operated; BLOCKED/OFF/OFF unchanged and asserted from config.py; no self-certification. status PASS is this reviewer's honest self-report (fail_gate_tripped=false); the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge (M6-P1809) decide closure.
